labels.rationale: Intended behaviour: Rich disables animations when output is not a terminal (docs/source/console.rst, Interactive mode). Reporter confirmed no action needed.

body:
Rich turns off live animations such as progress bars when its output is not a terminal, which includes output piped through `tee`. This is the documented behaviour, see [Interactive mode](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/console.rst). To keep animations in a non-terminal, pass `force_interactive=True` to the `Console`. For further questions, please use [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
